statement: A top-3 compute jurisdiction legislates guaranteed public access to frontier AI, or an AI dividend or sovereign fund paid to citizens (official gazette, by 2028-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met in 2025 and no bill was pending. Bloc A's executive ordered a plan for a national sovereign wealth fund (not AI-specific, no citizen payout) and its national AI plan contained no public-access guarantee. Bloc B's 'AI+' policy set adoption targets and 'inclusive' language but no legal access right or dividend. AI-dividend and public-wealth-fund ideas circulated only in think-tank and lab-researcher essays.

items.summary: Bloc A's head of government ordered a plan for a national sovereign wealth fund within 90 days. Not AI-specific and with no citizen dividend; later cited by advocates of an AI-funded public wealth fund.
items.detail: Executive Order 14196 'A Plan for Establishing a Bloc A Sovereign Wealth Fund' (signed 2025-02-03). No fund was legislated in 2025. Not verified via web_extract this run.

items.summary: Policy essay by researchers at a frontier developer and a governance think tank proposed 'predistribution': national AI sovereign wealth funds, AI bonds paying citizen dividends, compute as a public utility. Advocacy only.
items.detail: Saffron Huang & Sam Manning, 'Here's How To Share AI's Future Wealth', Noema, 2025-04-22.

items.summary: Think-tank proposal for a Bloc A strategic sovereign wealth fund taking minority stakes in frontier AI firms and paying universal basic dividends on the model of a state oil-revenue fund.
items.detail: Liam Epstein (Convergence Analysis), 'Lead, Own, Share: Sovereign Wealth Funds for Transformative AI', SSRN 5343934, July 2025 (day approximate; listed in Windfall Trust Policy Atlas).

items.summary: Bloc A's national AI action plan focused on deregulation, infrastructure and exports; it contained no guaranteed public access to frontier AI and no dividend mechanism.
items.detail: 'Bloc A's AI Action Plan', White House, 2025-07-23. Research-access pilot (NAIRR) covers researchers, not the general public.

items.summary: Bloc B's cabinet issued an 'AI+' policy targeting >70% penetration of intelligent terminals/agents by 2027 and 'inclusive' sharing of AI benefits; a policy opinion, not a statutory access guarantee or dividend.
items.detail: State Council 'Opinions on Deeply Implementing the AI+ Action' (国务院关于深入实施'人工智能+'行动的意见), dated 2025-08-21, published ~2025-08-26/27. Not verified via web_extract this run.

items.summary: No bill to guarantee public access to frontier AI or to create an AI dividend/sovereign fund was introduced in any top-3 compute jurisdiction during 2025 (first such Bloc A bill came in 2026).
items.detail: Searches of 2025 legislative trackers found none; the Bloc A A.I. Sovereign Wealth Fund Act (S. 4825) was announced in 2026 and is outside this phase - mentioned only to mark the as-of boundary.
